asr.full_text: Alina Brasova Reviewer:"Sypheria S. Četračić The devil went down to Georgia, he was looking for a soul to steal. He was in a bind because he was way behind and he was willing to make a deal. When he came across this young man sewing on a fiddle and playing it hot, and the devil jumped up on a hickory stump and said, I guess you didn't know it, but I'm a fiddle player too. And if you'd care to take a dare I'll make a bet with you Now you play a pretty good fiddle, boy, but give the devil as due I bet a fiddle of gold against your soul because I think I bet her too. The boy said, My name's John, and it might be a sin But I'll take your bet you're going to regret Because I'm the best that's ever been. John, here arms & up your po'n, play your fiddle hard Because hell's Poblousin, Georgia, & the devil reels the cards And if you & coin, play your fiddle hard cause hell's propulsive, Georgia and the devil deals the cards and if you win you get this shiny fiddle made of gold but if you lose the devil gets your soul But the devil opened up his case and said I'll start this show fire flew from his finger tips and rasped his bow He pulled the bow across the strings and it made a evil hit and then band of Demons joined in and it sounded something like this When the devil finished, Johnny said, Well, you're pretty good, old son, But sit down in that chair right there And let me show you how it's done. Fire on the mountain, run, boys, run. The devil's in the house of the rising sun. Chicken in the bread pan, picking out duds. The devil bowed his head because he knew that he'd been beat And he laid that golden fiddle on the ground at Johnny's feet Johnny said, devil, just come on back if you ever want to try again I done told you once, you son of a bitch, I'm the best there's ever been He played bow and a bound and run, boy, run Thanks for watching!

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a group flash-mob dance performance in an entertainment venue, with coordinated movements and clapping. The audio consists mainly of lyrics from "The Devil Went Down to Georgia" and ends with "Thanks for watching!", consistent with a music or performance video. The described material contains no request for payment, credentials, investment participation, or another deceptive action.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The title calls this a flash mob, supplied frames show people dancing together, and the transcript contains song lyrics. This supports general entertainment content.
